mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: unsupported object name branch: lit candle timer adjustment

summary: The first miss is objnam.c doname_base(): naming the newly wished-for lit candle needs its BURN_OBJECT timer adjustment. After that branch, the intended throw reaches a separate unported snuff_candle() call in dothrow.c throwit().

source.branch: For a lit wax or tallow candle in doname_base(), calculate remaining burn time from obj->age and, while lit, add peek_timer(BURN_OBJECT, &timer) - svm.moves before deciding whether to prefix “partly used”; append “(lit)” afterward.
callers: C: objnam.c doname() calls doname_base() (1754); zap.c makewish() calls doname(otmp) at 6388 before hold_another_object(), reached from wizcmds.c wiz_wish() at 38.

JavaScript: js/zap.js makewish() calls donameFresh() before object placement; js/wizcmds.js wiz_wish() calls makewish(). donameFresh() reaches donameFreshInternal() and preflightDoname() in js/objnam.js.
dependencies: timeout.c peek_timer() (2324) looks up the absolute timeout for BURN_OBJECT and the same object; the candle branch subtracts svm.moves. JavaScript has the corresponding timer lookup in js/timeout.js peek_timer().
The full-burn threshold uses objects[obj->otyp].oc_cost; JavaScript objectType(obj).oc_cost is already available to the formatter.

evidence: The assigned scan artifact .cache/synthetic-scans/v15/wizard-throws-lit-wax-candle-o-slot-extinguishes-flame.json records the first stop at step 25 as “unsupported object name branch: lit candle timer adjustment”. The supplied C recording challenges/cases/v15/wizard-throws-lit-wax-candle-o-slot-extinguishes-flame.session.json shows “o - a candle (lit).” at step 25 and, after the throw and direction inputs, “The candle’s flame is extinguished.” at step 28.

The first source owner is objnam.c doname_base(), defined at 1223; its candle suffix branch at 1458–1483 uses obj->age, objects[otyp].oc_cost, obj->lamplit, peek_timer(BURN_OBJECT), and svm.moves. The JavaScript whole-function counterpart is represented by donameFreshInternal() in js/objnam.js; its current candle modifier compares only obj.age and preflightDoname() refuses a lit candle at js/objnam.js:449. C zap.c makewish() calls doname(otmp) at 6388 before hold_another_object(), so this naming branch blocks the #wizwish setup before the throw begins.

The timer dependency is timeout.c peek_timer() at 2324, which returns the matching object timer’s absolute timeout or zero; this routine already has a JavaScript counterpart in js/timeout.js. The investigation scope is the complete objnam.c doname_base() function, not just the candle conditional, because the selection rules require whole-function ports.

A separate later gap is exposed by the target behavior: after landing, dothrow.c throwit() calls (void) snuff_candle(obj) at 1818. apply.c snuff_candle() at 1472 prints the extinguished-flame message and calls end_burn(otmp, TRUE). js/dothrow.js:2693 currently records note_unported('apply.c snuff_candle') in that landing path. This does not cause the first stop at step 25; it remains a separate source scope required to produce the step-28 extinguishing result after the naming miss is repaired.
